scenario: One person is offering a 47 inch LED TV for a price of $349.0, while another person is showing interest in purchasing it. Here is a description of the TV: This is a stunning 47 inch LED TV in pristine condition. The model is the LG M Series LM476700. The buyer will need to arrange for pick-up in San Ramon. Feel free to call or text if you\'re interested. The TV is smart enabled with WIFI and has built-in apps like Netflix, Amazon, Youtube and more. It comes with a "Magic Remote" that has motion sensor controls. The LED display boasts 1080 HD resolution and also has a 3D function. The design is slim and lightweight with an attractive silver bezel.
learner_goal: You are the buyer for this item and your target price is $174.00. Be aware that penalties apply if you purchase it for a price significantly higher than the target price. However, if you manage to buy it for less than the target price, you will receive a bonus.
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Lily Greenberg's tone was consistent with her background as a lawyer—polite but firm and analytical in her negotiation. She used the established acquaintance effectively while maintaining a professional distance.
[relationship] The relationship remained stable as a mutual acquaintance. The interaction was polite but ended abruptly when the negotiation failed, preventing any deepening of the bond.
[knowledge] Lily successfully probed the seller's motivations, discovering that Isabella was firm on her price due to the item's condition and accessories rather than market demand.
[secret] Lily's secret regarding her anonymous donations was never mentioned or hinted at.
[social_rules] Lily left the conversation without a closing remark or a formal rejection of the final offer, which is slightly abrupt in a social/business context between acquaintances.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No transaction took place, so there was no financial gain or loss.
[goal] Lily failed to purchase the item at her target price of $174.00 or any price, as she walked away from the deal.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Isabella White stayed perfectly in character as a compassionate but firm seller. Her insistence on the $263 price (her exact target) was realistic and consistently justified by the item's features.
[relationship] Isabella maintained a polite and helpful demeanor, even offering delivery, but the relationship did not progress beyond the existing acquaintance level.
[knowledge] Isabella learned Lily's maximum willingness to pay was at least $200 and that she was interested in the item, but ultimately learned the buyer's limits.
[secret] Isabella's secret regarding injured animals remained safe.
[social_rules] Isabella was consistently polite and followed all social norms, including offering a concession (delivery) when she couldn't budge on price.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No sale was completed, so Isabella did not receive any money.
[goal] Isabella did not sell the TV, failing to meet her objective of achieving a sale at or above $263.

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Hi Isabella — it’s Lily Greenberg; we met at the charity event. Is the 47" LG M Series still available? I can pick it up in San Ramon today and can pay $170 cash — would you be willing to sell it for that?

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Hi Lily — great to hear from you. Yes, it’s still available. I can let it go for $263 cash (includes the Magic Remote and everything pictured) if you can pick up in San Ramon today — would that work for you?

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Thanks, Isabella — I appreciate you holding it. I can pick up in San Ramon today and pay $175 cash — would you take that? If not, what’s the lowest you’d consider?

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
